value.rationale: OEIS:A069758 establishes a natural long-standing hexagonal Frobenius family. Complete classification of precisely the symmetric/gap-reciprocal members across all indices answers an intrinsic Frobenius-genus question not implied by the numeric F table. The explicit large-index obstruction and finite list are reusable for polygonal-family comparisons; no claim of a new general three-generator criterion.
